rows.jp: しばらくそうしていたが、やがて四角い自分にも飽きてきた。
rows.en: I stayed that way for a while, but eventually even being a rectangular solid got old.

ghs.en: I stayed like this for a while, but soon I got tired of my rectangular self.

rows.jp: 祠の内部には、異常はまったく感じられない。
rows.en: Nothing inside the shrine felt abnormal in the slightest.

ghs.en: I could feel absolutely no abnormality in the interior of the hokora.

rows.jp: それでもやはり、ここは時間の流れがおかしいのだ。
rows.en: Even so, time unquestionably flowed strangely here.

ghs.en: However, certainly, the flow of time here is strange.

rows.jp: 祠側が健全で、街側がおかしいというのが正しいか。
rows.en: Or rather, perhaps the shrine was normal and the town was wrong.

ghs.en: Perhaps more correctly, next to the hokora it is wholesome, while it's around the town that it's strange.

rows.jp: とりあえず出る。
rows.en: For now, I climbed out.

ghs.en: For now I come out,

rows.jp: ノートを戻しておく。
rows.en: I returned the notebook.

ghs.en: and return the notebooks inside.

rows.jp: 情報は大切だ。
rows.en: Information was precious.

ghs.en: Information is precious.

rows.jp: ここにある情報は多ければ多いけど良い。
rows.en: The more information stored here, the better.

ghs.en: The more information there is here the better it is.

rows.jp: たとえば今の俺にリセットがかかったとしても、曜子ちゃんならかなりの確立で毎回祠を突き止めるだろう。
rows.en: Even if my mind were reset now, there was a high probabillity that Youko would find the shrine every time.

ghs.en: Even if me as I am right now were to be reset, for example, Youko-chan will have good chances to be able to determine the facts of the hokora every time.

rows.jp: ノートを見れば、今俺が考えた程度の結論には、瞬時に到達できるはずだ。
rows.en: One look at the notebooks, and she should instantly reach the same basic conclusions I had.

ghs.en: If she looks at the notebooks, she could likely reach in a single instant a final word of the same level as the one I, as I presently am, just thought up.

rows.jp: 「……そうか、制服か」
rows.en: “...Of course. The uniform.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...right, that uniform then."

rows.jp: 七香の制服。
rows.en: Nanaka’s uniform.

ghs.en: Nanaka's uniform.

rows.jp: 見たこともないデザイン。
rows.en: A design I had never seen before.

ghs.en: It's a design I have never seen.

rows.jp: これはヒントになる。
rows.en: That could be a clue.

ghs.en: This will be a hint.

rows.jp: また彼女と出会えるとは限らないからな。
rows.en: There was no guarantee I would ever meet her again.

ghs.en: Meeting her again might not be necessarily possible.

rows.jp: 七香を捜すという選択肢もあるが。
rows.en: I could always choose to search for Nanaka, but...

ghs.en: There is the choice of searching for this Nanaka, but,

rows.jp: 俺の持ってる制服図鑑には、掲載されていなかったはずだ。
rows.en: I was fairly sure she did not appear in my encyclopedia of school uniforms.

ghs.en: I do not expect that that design would be published in the school uniform reference books that I own.

rows.jp: うーん、あの図鑑に載ってないということは……。
rows.en: Hmm. If she wasn’t even in that book...

ghs.en: No-ope, that wouldn't be in that reference book, therefore...

rows.jp: 「わからん」
rows.en: “I have no idea.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Dunno."

rows.jp: 保留だな。
rows.en: That question would have to wait.

ghs.en: Let's just put this on hold.

rows.jp: もし次に遭遇したら、尋問しなければならない。
rows.en: If I encountered her again, I would have to interrogate her.

ghs.en: Supposing there is a next encounter, then I will just have to interrogate her.

rows.jp: さて。
rows.en: Now then.

ghs.en: So then,

rows.jp: 学校に行くか。
rows.en: I might as well go to school.

ghs.en: To school, then?

rows.jp: とりあえず俺がすべきは、毎日を過ごして日記を書くこと。
rows.en: For the moment, my task was simply to live each day and keep a diary.

ghs.en: For the time being, it is expected of me to write in the diary how I spend my everyday.

rows.jp: それしかないように思った。
rows.en: There seemed to be nothing else I could do.

ghs.en: That's all that I could do, I thought.
